صَيْدَانٌ Pieces of silver, (M, TA,) when struck from the stone [or ore] thereof: (TA:) n. un. with ة. (M, TA.) [See also صَيْدَنٌ, above, last signification. And see صَيْدَانٌ in art. صيد.] ―
-b2- And Stone cooking-pots: (M, TA:) in this sense [likewise] a coll. gen. n.: n. un. with ة. (IB and L in art. صيد, in which it is mentioned in the S and L and K.) [See, again, صَيْدَانٌ, and also صَيْدَآءُ, in art. صيد.] ―
-b3- And Small pebbles: (IAar, M, TA:) or so صَيْدَانُ الحَصَى. (L in art. صيد.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
